title: CIA implants a chip in Lynn Kyle's skull, the origin of the tinfoil hat

tellings.quote: and unfortunately his his psychologist was worked for the CIA and they put a chip in his skull without telling him

plain: On the podcast of a host named Jesse Michels, a comedian and guest named Kurt Metzger tells a story about a man called Lynn Kyle, which he links to the start of the idea of wearing a tinfoil hat. Metzger says Kyle's psychologist secretly worked for the CIA, the US spy agency, and that they put a chip in his skull without telling him, a story he connects to the name Carlos Delgado. If true, it would mean the agency was secretly experimenting on people's brains.
